fields.Name: C2 -> S2.5
fields.Description: Gate G2.23 (phase 2, dataset C2, criterion S2.5): the holdout's positive rate lies inside the 95% interval of the population rate, 1 of 1; any reweighting is fitted inside the training folds; 0 row IDs are shared between training and holdout. A seeded-random 0.25 holdout; the population rate is the snapshot's class balance; the holdout is the manifest's locked-holdout rows, its positives read from Scn_C2.Target, and the stored carve summary must agree with both; the interval is Wilson's; the in-fold half is the pytest node tests/test_selection.py::test_in_fold_undersampling_never_touches_validation_rows. It fails when the class reweighting is fitted before the inner folds are cut (the in-fold node fails).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Holdout positive rate inside the population rate's 95% interval; resampling in-fold (1 of 1 pytest case); 0 shared row ids.
